name: Execute Command
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: The Execute Command node runs shell commands on the host machine that runs n8n

parameters.name: Execute Once
parameters.description: Choose whether you want the node to execute only once (turned on) or once for every item it receives as input (turned off)

parameters.name: Command
parameters.description: Enter the command to execute on the host machine. Refer to sections below for examples of running multiple commands and cURL commands

parameters.name: Run multiple commands
parameters.description: Use one of two methods to run multiple commands in one Execute Command node:

parameters.name: Run cURL command
parameters.description: You can also use the HTTP Request node to make a cURL request

common_issues.title: Command failed: <command> /bin/sh: <command>: not found
common_issues.summary: This error occurs when the shell environment can't find one of the commands in the Command parameter

common_issues.title: Error: stdout maxBuffer length exceeded
common_issues.summary: This error happens when your command returns more output than the Execute Command node is able to process at one time

common_issues.title: PowerShell commands get truncated at line breaks
common_issues.summary: On Windows, the Execute Command node passes the Command parameter to the system shell as a single string. If your command contains line breaks, the shell only executes the first line and ignores the rest

parameters.name: executeOnce
parameters.description: Whether to execute only once instead of once for each entry
